name: Grilled Tofu Pita with Raspberry BBQ Sauce, Asparagus & Peppers
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel garlic; add to the blender with the orange juice along with raspberries, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and spices. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is very smooth, about 1 minute; set aside.
Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; place on a plate. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; add tofu and grill, flipping once, until charred and warmed through, 5-7 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers crosswise into 1-inch wide strips; place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then gently toss to coat.
Once the tofu is done, working in batches if necessary, add veggies to the pan; grill, flipping once, until tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the bowl.

To assemble, cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; spread each pocket with 1 tablespoon of the BBQ sauce. Stuff with tofu and drizzle with another 1 tablespoon of the sauce. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Divide pitas and grilled veggies between plates; serve with remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
